title: Motor Vehicle Information – Registrar’s decisions and notifications
text:
Registrar’s Decisions: Notification 07/2025 (RDN 07/2025)
Statistics Canada (StatCan) is requesting access to personal driving and motor vehicle information for StatCan’s Census of Population, which is a part of StatCan’s Census Program. The Census of Population provides a statistical portrait of Canada and Canadians on one specific day, every 5 years. The personal driving and motor vehicle information released by the Registrar of Motor Vehicle Services (Information) to StatCan’s Census Program is used by StatCan to conduct the Census of Population, which includes updating the demographic information required for the Census of Population.
Registrar’s Decisions: Notification (RDN) 07/2025
notifies the public about the Registrar of Motor Vehicle Services (Registrar’s) periodic release of Information to StatCan’s Census Program for the purpose of conducting StatCan’s Census of Population. Specifics regarding StatCan’s authority to request Information and the Registrar’s authority to release Information are in
RDN 07/2025
.
